purpose_zh: 品牌与标识规范机器可读版：Logo 方向、色号系统、最小尺寸、安全留白与禁用规则
purpose_en: Machine-readable brand & identity specification: logo direction, color system, minimum sizes, clear space and usage rules
boundary_zh: 品牌规范为概念建议，不含任何商标注册、授权或官方背书主张；字符标识为独立绘制
boundary_en: Brand specification is conceptual; no trademark registration, licensing or official endorsement claimed; character marks are independently drawn
logo_direction_zh: 「人」字形折返符号 + JZ Valley 标准字组合，横式为主、竖式为辅
logo_direction_en: Ren-shaped switchback symbol + JZ Valley wordmark, horizontal primary, vertical secondary
clear_space_zh: 标识四周保留至少标识高度 0.5 倍的空间
application_zh: A0/A3 展板统一深轨蓝底色+验证绿数据色；数字展示用深色模式（#1a1a2e 背景）白色文字
